figs.name: joukowsky-equation-water-hammer-pipeline-diagram
figs.alt: joukowsky equation water hammer diagram with reservoir, steel pipe, closing valve and pressure wave
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing water hammer: water at 2.5 m/s stopped by a sudden valve closure sends a 3.0 MPa pressure wave back at 1200 m/s.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Water hammer pressure wave in a steel pipeline after sudden valve closure</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Water Hammer After Sudden Valve Closure</text>
<rect x="30" y="130" width="120" height="200" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="32" y="160" width="116" height="168" rx="0" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#bfdbfe" stroke-width="0"/>
<text x="90" y="120" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reservoir</text>
<text x="90" y="215" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Water</text>
<text x="90" y="240" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1000 kg/m³</text>
<rect x="150" y="280" width="470" height="40" rx="0" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="470" y="282" width="150" height="36" rx="0" fill="#fca5a5" stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-width="0"/>
<line x1="149" y1="282" x2="149" y2="318" stroke="#bfdbfe" stroke-width="4"/>
<rect x="670" y="280" width="100" height="40" rx="0" fill="#f3f4f6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polygon points="620,275 670,325 670,275 620,325" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="645" y1="300" x2="645" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="620" y1="240" x2="670" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="645" y="222" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Valve closes suddenly</text>
<line x1="200" y1="262" x2="330" y2="262" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="265" y="250" font-size="18" fill="#1d4ed8" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flow V₁ = 2.5 m/s</text>
<text x="720" y="265" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V₂ = 0</text>
<line x1="610" y1="345" x2="470" y2="345" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="520" y="375" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pressure wave travels back at a = 1200 m/s</text>
<line x1="150" y1="410" x2="620" y2="410" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)" marker-start="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="385" y="438" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Pipe length L, steel pipeline</text>
<text x="400" y="490" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Surge at the valve: ΔP = 1000 × 1200 × 2.5 = 3.0 MPa, about 30 bar</text>
</svg>

figs.name: joukowsky-equation-surge-calculation-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to calculate water hammer surge pressure and check valve closing time
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the surge calculation steps: density, wave speed, velocity change, pressure rise, closing time check against 2L/a and pipe rating check.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for water hammer surge pressure calculation and closing time check</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Surge Pressure Calculation Steps</text>
<rect x="25" y="60" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140.0" y="94.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fluid density ρ</text>
<text x="140.0" y="117.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">water 1000 kg/m³</text>
<rect x="285" y="60" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="94.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wave speed a</text>
<text x="400.0" y="117.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">steel pipe 1200 m/s</text>
<rect x="545" y="60" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="660.0" y="94.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Velocity change ΔV</text>
<text x="660.0" y="117.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2.5 minus 0 = 2.5 m/s</text>
<line x1="140" y1="140" x2="300" y2="183" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="400" y1="140" x2="400" y2="183" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="660" y1="140" x2="500" y2="183" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="185" width="400" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="219.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ΔP = ρ × a × ΔV</text>
<text x="400.0" y="243.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1000 × 1200 × 2.5 = 3.0 MPa</text>
<line x1="400" y1="265" x2="400" y2="293" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,295.0 550.0,345 400,395.0 250.0,345" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="340.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Closing time tc</text>
<text x="400" y="362.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">below 2L/a?</text>
<line x1="250" y1="345" x2="222" y2="345" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="236" y="333" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="20" y="310" width="200" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="339.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Full surge</text>
<text x="120.0" y="363.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">about 30 bar</text>
<line x1="550" y1="345" x2="578" y2="345" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="564" y="333" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="580" y="310" width="200" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="680.0" y="339.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">tc above 2L/a</text>
<text x="680.0" y="363.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">surge is smaller</text>
<line x1="120" y1="380" x2="230" y2="458" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="680" y1="380" x2="570" y2="458" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="150" y="460" width="500" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="494.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Check pipe pressure rating</text>
<text x="400.0" y="517.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">normal 8 bar but transient 30 bar: rate for 30 bar</text>
<text x="400" y="572" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Article example: closing slower than 0.67 s gives far less than 3 MPa</text>
</svg>

figs.name: joukowsky-equation-worked-example-infographic
figs.alt: water hammer worked example 1000 kg/m3, 1200 m/s and 2.5 m/s giving 3.0 MPa surge
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the worked example ΔP = 1000 × 1200 × 2.5 = 3.0 MPa and typical wave speeds for steel, PVC and copper pipes.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Joukowsky equation worked example and typical wave speeds by pipe material</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Joukowsky Equation Worked Example</text>
<text x="400" y="82" font-size="30" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ΔP = ρ × a × ΔV</text>
<rect x="25" y="105" width="176" height="125" rx="14" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="113" y="140" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ρ</text>
<text x="113" y="180" font-size="23" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1000 kg/m³</text>
<text x="113" y="212" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">water</text>
<rect x="217" y="105" width="176" height="125" rx="14" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="305" y="140" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">a</text>
<text x="305" y="180" font-size="23" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1200 m/s</text>
<text x="305" y="212" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">steel pipe</text>
<rect x="409" y="105" width="176" height="125" rx="14" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="497" y="140" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ΔV</text>
<text x="497" y="180" font-size="23" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2.5 m/s</text>
<text x="497" y="212" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2.5 to 0 m/s</text>
<rect x="601" y="105" width="176" height="125" rx="14" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="689" y="140" font-size="24" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ΔP</text>
<text x="689" y="180" font-size="23" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.0 MPa</text>
<text x="689" y="212" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">about 30 bar</text>
<text x="400" y="278" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Typical wave speed a for water lines</text>
<text x="30" y="347" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Steel pipe</text>
<rect x="560.0" y="330" width="108.0" height="22" rx="4" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="614.0" y="322" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1000 to 1300 m/s</text>
<text x="30" y="409" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">PVC pipe</text>
<rect x="308.0" y="392" width="36.0" height="22" rx="4" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="326.0" y="384" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">300 to 400 m/s</text>
<text x="30" y="471" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Copper tube</text>
<rect x="632.0" y="454" width="72.0" height="22" rx="4" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="668.0" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1200 to 1400 m/s</text>
<line x1="200" y1="505" x2="740" y2="505" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="200.0" y1="505" x2="200.0" y2="515" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<line x1="380.0" y1="505" x2="380.0" y2="515" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">500</text>
<line x1="560.0" y1="505" x2="560.0" y2="515" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560.0" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1000</text>
<line x1="740.0" y1="505" x2="740.0" y2="515" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="740.0" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1500</text>
<line x1="200" y1="505" x2="200" y2="505" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="752" y="511" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">m/s</text>
<text x="400" y="568" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Flexible pipe walls lower a, so the surge pressure is lower</text>
</svg>
